ui.trackIndexDescription: A guide to running Claude Code, Codex, or any CLI agent on a machine you own, and reaching it from your phone over SSH.
ui.ctaLine: 14-day full-feature trial, available on iOS and Android.

beginner.title: I've never opened a terminal
beginner.blurb: You write code with AI but have never touched SSH. Start at what a shell does, then SSH.

cliuser.title: I already run CLI agents
cliuser.blurb: Claude Code or Codex already runs on your Mac. What's missing is SSH, tmux, and the address to type.

why-remote-vibe-coding.title: Your AI should be working while you sleep
why-remote-vibe-coding.description: The cost of running agents remotely is standby: the agent waits on you. tmux and SSH move that wait to your phone.

why-not-gui-ide.title: Why not Cursor or VS Code
why-not-gui-ide.description: On a desktop the IDE agent usually wins. On a phone a terminal wins: a byte stream can be stored and reattached.

troubleshooting.title: Stuck? Start here
troubleshooting.description: SSH refused, key rejected, tmux missing, claude not found: eight failures, each with a cause and a command to type.

what-is-cli.title: Why the strongest coding agents live in the terminal
what-is-cli.description: Why coding agents live in a terminal: full filesystem access and permission to execute. What a shell is, and when a GUI tool wins.

what-is-ssh.title: SSH is a tunnel to a machine you own
what-is-ssh.description: SSH is an encrypted channel to another computer: host, user and port, why keys beat passwords, and why no port faces the internet.

what-is-tmux.title: Keep the agent running after you put your phone away
what-is-tmux.description: tmux is a terminal multiplexer: the session lives on the server, so a dropped SSH detaches instead of killing the agent.

what-is-tailscale.title: Tailscale: no port open to the internet
what-is-tailscale.description: Tailscale builds a WireGuard mesh between your own devices, so your phone connects to a MagicDNS name or a 100.x address and no port opens.

why-agentmux.title: Why not Termius or Blink
why-agentmux.description: Agentmux vs Termius and Blink: five capability differences, and the cases where Termius is the better tool.

setup.title: 15 minutes to an agent that works all night
setup.description: Answer three questions and get the steps for your machine, the agent you want to run, and where you connect from: SSH, tmux, Tailscale.

claude-code-on-iphone.title: Run Claude Code on your iPhone or iPad
claude-code-on-iphone.description: Claude Code runs on a machine you own, not on the phone. Remote Login, Tailscale, a named tmux session, and the PATH problem SSH causes.

permission-review.title: AI Permission Review: who answers when your agent asks
permission-review.description: Who answers when an agent asks to run a command: a local blacklist blocks it, an allowlist clears it, or AI judgement decides.

windows-server.title: Your Windows PC can be the server
windows-server.description: Native Windows over OpenSSH, sessions kept alive by psmux, and what is still different from a Linux box. No WSL2 needed.
